question: Have I put anything before God? (e.g., money, success, a relationship)
Have I doubted God's love or mercy?
Have I neglected prayer or my relationship with God?
Have I used God's name in vain or cursed?
Have I honored God on the Sabbath by attending Mass and resting?
Have I acted in a way that caused harm to others, either physically or emotionally?
Have I been angry, resentful, or unforgiving towards anyone?
Have I committed adultery or been unfaithful to my spouse?
Have I looked at others lustfully or used pornography?
Have I stolen anything, no matter how small?
Have I been envious or jealous of others' possessions or success?
Have I lied, gossiped, or slandered another person?
Have I been honest in my work and with my finances?
Have I wasted my time or talents, or neglected my duties at home, work, or school?
Have I been prideful, arrogant, or selfish?
Have I been unkind in my thoughts, words, or actions toward others?
Have I been a good friend, spouse, parent, or child?
Have I been patient and kind?
Have I held on to grudges or refused to forgive others?
Have I failed to love my neighbor as myself?
Have I been disobedient or disrespectful to my parents?
Have I been ungrateful for my parents' sacrifices or love?
Have I been attentive to my parents' needs, especially as they grow older?
Have I been lazy or apathetic in my studies or homework?
Have I been a good witness to my faith in the workplace?
Have I disciplined my children justly and out of love, not anger?
Have I been selfish with my time, resources, or affections?
Have I been honest in my work and with my finances?
